Nina Park: Heads-up: a customer saw repeated defer -> client timeout -> retry -> defer loops when the tiling policy sent traffic to cheap pools. We should decide a mitigations set.

Theo Wallace: Yikes. Quick ideas: attach a decision token so retries know a defer already happened; or make defer a one-shot per parent_request_id with a TTL.

Jordan Li: Both. Central policy should provide a default 'defer_window_ms' and runtime should enforce it locally. Runtime enforcement avoids an RPC on hot path.

Nina Park: Agreed. Need to be explicit about what happens on retry: if parent_request_id seen within defer_window -> do not defer again, instead follow fallback_strategy.

Theo Wallace: Fallback strategies: immediate-fallback, hedge-first (send parallel to faster pool), or retry-later (queue briefly). Hedge-first reduces client timeouts but costs more. We need per-tenant budget guardrails.

Jordan Li: Security: token must be HMACed for private installs. Telemetry should include decision_id, parent_request_id, defer_hit (bool), defer_window_ms, token_sig_ok. Latency hist buckets too.

Nina Park: Minimal YAML example: ```policy:
  defer_on_slow: true
  defer_window_ms: 2000
  fallback_strategy: immediate-fallback
  emit_telemetry: [decision_id,parent_request_id,defer_hit,latency_histogram]```

Theo Wallace: Experiment plan: canary sidecar (10%) with runtime check and default 2s window. Capture telemetry and run synthetic retry replay. If client timeouts fall and cost delta <5% widen rollout.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: sidecar/0.12.3 -> canary(10%) starting 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Release notes: decision token, defer_window enforcement, telemetry additions.

Nina Park: Action items: @Theo make HMAC lib, @Jordan update telemetry schema + dashboards, I'll prepare replay for that customer's trace. Revisit in 48h with canary metrics.
